subject: CS362
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. High-quality, highly-viewed channels like 3Blue1Brown and StatQuest were chosen for English. For Arabic, selections were made from the best available candidates, sometimes invoking the low-view-count exception rule and correcting for inaccurate language metadata.

coverage.note: Multiple highly relevant candidates failed the duration gate (>3600s), so a video focused on the Gradient Descent math was chosen.
No candidates passed the 3000 view count gate; selected the highest-view video above 500 per exception rule.
